name: gio-uniapp-autotracker
description: Traditional uni-app Vue 3 App and mini-program analytics SDK

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.test:release: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:coverage
scripts.demo:check: pnpm run build:sdk && tsc --noEmit -p test/type/tsconfig.compiled-consumer.json && tsx scripts/check-demo.ts
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm run test:release && pnpm run build:sdk && tsx scripts/prepare-release.ts && pnpm run release:check
scripts.release:check: tsx scripts/check-release.ts && tsx scripts/check-package-consumers.ts && tsc --noEmit -p test/type/tsconfig.compiled-consumer.json && tsx scripts/check-demo.ts && pnpm run test:miniprogram:compile
scripts.release:publish: pnpm run test:release && pnpm run release:check && tsx scripts/publish-release.ts
